Messages.Author: Neil Bernstein
Messages.Body:
And Eliza of Clan Tremere, our friendly exemplars in the new, not-to-be-
posted-to-rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad rulebook; are they:

New vampires to be released in VTES? This would tend to contradict what
we've heard, that VTES is just a clean-up of Jyhad.

Names made up for the sake of example? This would be odd, considering the
old rulebook used actual Jyhad vampires as examples.

- Neil

>And Eliza of Clan Tremere, our friendly exemplars in the new, not-to-be-

>
>New vampires to be released in VTES? This would tend to contradict what

>

>Names made up for the sake of example? This would be odd, considering the
>old rulebook used actual Jyhad vampires as examples.

They are names made up for the sake of example. I don't know why they
changed to using vampires that don't appear on cards in the examples;
probably it was for no particular reason. Also, VTES does delete a few
cards, and replace them with a handful that didn't appear in Jyhad.

Messages.Body:

: Are you authorized to say which cards will be deleted?

Except for the early release of the Chronicles list, which was intended to
protect consumers against a leak, the Wizards have never said what's in or
out of any of their TCGs before the rest of the world knows. Speculation
is a Bad Thing, you know.
